HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
   B. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   B. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Religious has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Say Basic Prayers has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

6. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
   C. Say Qualities Of Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.
   C. Say General Etiquette: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use General Etiquette: to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs
